title: 67 days to election: Share recent Joga-Iboro engagement as Peter Obi advances accountability and productivity message
summary: With 67 days until 16 January 2027, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues ward-level mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon, including recent work captured in the gallery from Joga-Iboro. Nationally, Peter Obi has been active with engagements in Enugu, Awka and a visit to LoveWorld Expo in Ogun State, while pressing for accountability on public resources. Share the local gallery image and the people-centred agenda paired with the national vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 68 days to election: Share Oluwadara Kehinde’s people-centred agenda as NDC town halls continue
summary: With 68 days until 16 January 2027, supporters are encouraged to engage friends and family with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s homegrown, transparent agenda for Yewa North / Imeko-Afon — youth empowerment, agriculture and value addition, entrepreneurship and small business, education and skills, accountable representation, and infrastructure and rural welfare. Nationally, Peter Obi and Kwankwaso continue town halls and listening sessions on unity, security, education, health and productivity. Share the local agenda paired with the national vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 71 days to election: NDC slams Tinubu’s fresh $7.7bn loan request as Oluwadara Kehinde advances local agenda
summary: With 71 days until 16 January 2027, the NDC National Presidential Campaign Council criticised President Tinubu’s latest request for a $7.7 billion (approx. ₦10.79 trillion) external loan to finance the 2026 budget deficit, calling it part of a “one week, new loan” pattern and accusing the National Assembly of rubber-stamping borrowings. The party urged Nigerians to use the ballot for accountability and support Peter Obi and Kwankwaso. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the national demand for fiscal responsibility with the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.
